candidate.title: What Is Chain-of-Thought Prompting in Generative AI?
candidate.description:
Ever wonder how AI comes up with answers? Unlock the mystery behind AI's thinking and say goodbye to mysterious black box responses with chain-of-thought prompting. Chain-of-thought, or CoT, prompting reveals the logical steps AI takes to solve problems. From solving math puzzles to grasping complex concepts, CoT breaks it down step-by-step, ensuring accurate and transparent responses. 

Read more
